summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a routine Form -6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 interim report (period ended 2026-09-30), the US-equivalent of a foreign private issuer quarterly results filing. The XBRL index references standard financial statement line items: convertible senior notes, royalty monetization agreements with Royalty Pharma for US Yorvipath and Skytrofa, restricted and performance stock units, warrants, treasury shares, and a September share repurchase program noted as an event after the reporting period. No transaction, tender, strategic review, or leadership event is disclosed. No deal terms are stated.
